goal: Make the website copy-paste setup path work from any local Claude or Codex chat while deferring all project selection to the KitCode Welcome window; setup is not complete until Welcome opens and the user saves with at least one project folder.

in: Add a shared short assistant setup prompt in integration-spec that works in any chat context without repo guessing.
Forbid `kitcode add`, `kitcode track`, and cwd/workspace inference during assistant-led paste setup.
Direct assistants to run `kitcode <agent> on`, verify integration status, and open Welcome (`kitcode setup` fallback) on the local machine.
State that success requires the user to finish Welcome: pick project folder(s), save, and optionally start tracking.
Derive web gateway Codex/Claude copy actions from the shared prompt and update gateway guidance copy.
Align the long `setupPromptFor` contract with the same Welcome-first boundary where it still mentions add/track.
Extend focused integration-spec and project-gateway checks for the new copy contract.
Harden Welcome window launch so it reveals only after content is ready, without dock or terminal flashing, and keep setup subprocesses detached and hidden.
out: No change to Welcome window behavior, onboarding IPC, tracker logic, or local-state schema.
No remote/cloud-to-local automation in v1; remote paste remains best-effort with local-machine guidance only.
No campaign/dashboard redesign beyond setup copy and guidance.

acceptance_criteria.summary: integration-spec exports `assistantSetupPromptFor(source)` with local-machine scope, any-chat compatibility, Node check, enable command, and explicit no-add/no-track rules.
Shared short prompt and gateway copy state that setup is not complete until the user saves Welcome with at least one project folder.
Web gateway Codex and Claude copy actions import and use `assistantSetupPromptFor` instead of a duplicated local prompt builder.
Long `setupPromptFor` keeps installer details but directs project registration and tracker start to Welcome instead of assistant add/track during initial setup.
Integration-spec and project-gateway checks assert no-add/no-track wording, Welcome success boundary, and shared prompt usage.

coverage_plan.summary: Assert shared paste prompt, long prompt alignment, and gateway import contract.
Assert gateway Welcome-first guidance and shared prompt wiring.

risks.summary: Duplicated web and CLI setup copy could diverge again.
risks.mitigation: Single shared `assistantSetupPromptFor` export and focused copy checks.

risks.summary: Users may paste into remote sessions where Welcome cannot open locally.
risks.mitigation: Explicit local-machine-only guidance in prompt and gateway copy.

implementation_handoff.summary: Centralize the short paste setup prompt in integration-spec, wire the web gateway to it, and align long setup prompt plus copy checks with Welcome-first success.
suggested_sequence: Add `assistantSetupPromptFor(source)` with local-only, no-add, Welcome-success rules.
Import it in project-gateway and tighten disconnected-gateway guidance copy.
Update `setupPromptFor` Welcome boundary and extend focused checks.
